Noise-C: https://github.com/rweather/noise-c
Commit cfe25410979a87391bb9ac8d4d4bef64e9f268c6
Portable subset for Noise_XX_25519_ChaChaPoly_BLAKE2s.
Original per-file copyright/license notices are preserved.
Local adaptation: Curve25519 basepoint multiplication uses the already bundled
Donna implementation, avoiding the separate Ed25519 implementation/tables.
Unsupported algorithm factories return NULL. Zephyr entropy fails closed.
All-zero X25519 shared secrets and null public keys are rejected. The receive
adapter supports explicit datagram nonces without changing cipher state on an
unauthenticated packet; core/secure.c enforces the replay window. A test build
can select the same 32-bit Donna path used on the microcontrollers.
The 32-bit Donna path replaces signed left shifts of potentially negative
limbs with bounded multiplication, and uses unsigned bit operations for
equality masks and byte packing. Both paths pass independent Cacophony vectors
under AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer with halt-on-error.

Heatshrink: https://github.com/atomicobject/heatshrink
Commit 7d419e1fa4830d0b919b9b6a91fe2fb786cf3280
